t: The $(5)Confiscation Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$() that gives it the ability to automatically take items away from a player. If a player is in the action area of an Interdiction Matrix, it will scan the player's inventory and seize any forbidden items found. This applies to all items regardless of whether they are being carried, worn, or stored in inventory.
$(5)没收模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的可选模块，赋予其自动没收玩家物品的能力。若玩家处于干涉矩阵的作用范围内，系统将扫描其物品栏，并没收所有被禁止的物品。该效果适用于所有物品，无论其是被携带、穿戴还是存放在物品栏中。

The Filter Mode setting and 9 associated slots that run along the bottom of the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$()'s GUI are used to configure the module's behavior. The Filter Mode setting has two states: Banned (default) and Allowed.$(br2)Confiscated items are collected to inventories adjacent to the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$().
$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()GUI界面底部的过滤模式设置及其关联的9个插槽，用于配置模块行为。过滤模式设置包含两种状态：“禁用”（默认）和“启用”。$(br2)被没收的物品将被收集至$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()相邻的容器中。

When the toggle button reads 'Banned', the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$() treats the 9 (red) slots as a list of forbidden items that must be confiscated. Only these items will be seized, the player will be permitted to keep any other items they have. If all 9 item slots are empty, the Matrix assumes every item must be confiscated from a player.
当切换按钮显示为“禁用”时，$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()将9个（红色）插槽视为必须没收的禁用物品列表。仅这些物品会被没收，玩家可保留其余所有物品。若全部9个物品插槽均为空，则干涉矩阵将默认没收玩家持有的所有物品。

If the toggle button reads 'Allowed', the Matrix treats the 9 (green) slots as a list of items the player is allowed to keep. Any other item will be confiscated. When all 9 slots are empty, the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$() assumes all items are permitted and will not confiscate anything.
若切换按钮显示为“启用”，则干涉矩阵将9个（绿色）插槽视为允许玩家保留的物品列表。其余所有物品都将被没收。当全部9个插槽均为空时，$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()将默认允许所有物品，不执行任何没收操作。
